objective: diff-review (4-lens, run r2 from scratch) GP2-4633 PartnerUserReserveExport on centralized-export-service origin/develop(3eef807)..origin/feat/GP2-4633(7d9bcf1); Design lens compared with canonical internal-transfer.export.ts and GetAllTransHisExportHandler.ts; each REF verified against head worktree 7d9bcf1.

claims.claim: buildFilter filters statuses with the arrow function `(s) => s === STATUS_SUCCESS`, whose parenthesised single argument violates the repo rule arrow-parens: as-needed (eslint reports 38:59 error).

PartnerUserReserveExport.getRequiredModelName returns the literal array ['TransHisModel', 'MerchantModel'], whereas the canonical sibling adapter InternalTransferExport returns transHisModelNames() so that the required model follows TRANS_HIS_EXPORT_SOURCE.

QueryHandlerFactory registers GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportQuery to the Mongo handler unconditionally, on the line before and outside the getTransHisExportSource() === 'postgres' branch that switches the other trans-his export handlers.

GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportQuery has only filter and sort, while the canonical GetAllTransHisExportQuery also carries a select projection parameter, so the new handler hardcodes its projection in the handler (SELECT_FIELDS) instead of receiving it from the query like the canonical export pure does.
The params file declares its own private ExceedDateRangeValidator class, a copy of the same class already declared in other params files of the repo, instead of reusing one shared validator.

PartnerUserReserveExportParams is a new standalone class that re-declares dateFr, dateTo, status, sortBy, sortType, instead of extending TransHisExportParams as the canonical InternalTransferExportParams does.

GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler pages with find(filter).sort(sort).select().limit(limit) and skip(cursor) over a sort that has no _id tie-breaker (default sort is only createdAt: -1), so rows inserted during the export or ties on createdAt can duplicate or drop rows between chunks.
buildFilter splits params.status with String(params.status).split(',') without trimming, while statusAfter on the next lines is trimmed with .map((s) => s.trim()).
ExceedDateRangeValidator only checks dateDiff <= MAX_DAYS_EXPORT and therefore accepts a dateTo earlier than dateFr (negative dateDiff).
getConfig builds fileName with moment().format('DD-MM-YYYY') without .utcOffset(7), whereas transformRow formats createdAt with moment(item.createdAt).utcOffset(7).
reserveBalance computes the balance after as `before - amount` or `before + amount` on JavaScript numbers produced by Number(raw).

safeText prefixes a single quote to any text starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR, and transformRow wraps user-controlled text cells (customerId, partnerUserId, phone, fullName, merchantCode, noted) with safeText.

PartnerUserReserveExport is exported in the object at the end of logics/index.ts, which ExportLogic iterates (Object.keys(AllProcessors)) to build processorMap, so the exportType lookup finds it without editing export.logic.ts.
The merchant lookup in GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler is wrapped in try/catch and on failure only logs a warning via mainProcess.logger?.warn.
buildSort treats the strings 'ASC' and 'ascend' as ascending sort directions.
GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler calls TransHis.countDocuments(filter) on every page, including when cursor is greater than zero.
